app_info.subtitle: Manage campaign lore
app_info.description: Archivist AI lets users browse and edit their tabletop campaign memory in ChatGPT: campaigns, characters, sessions, story beats, moments, factions, locations, items, quests, journals, journal folders, entity links, and entity images. Write tools can create, update, and delete records (subject to the caller's permissions and agent_write scope) and can generate or upload entity images.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only asks a natural-language question against one campaign's existing knowledge and returns an answer with citations; it does not create or edit campaign records.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not publish content or change public internet state; it only reads the authenticated user's Archivist AI data.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Queues campaign-wide wikilink add/remove/update maintenance that rewrites referring text fields, so it changes campaign data.
justifications.open_world_justification: Operates only on the authenticated user's private Archivist AI campaign data and does not publish content or change public internet state on its own.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete entities; it queues bounded link add/remove/update rewrites that change text markup and Link rows but are not irreversible account-admin deletions.

test_cases.description: List available campaigns for the authenticated user. Demo account contains a single seeded campaign; listing may return one result.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns a paginated campaign list with at least one campaign, including title, description, system, and pagination fields (total, current_page, per_page).

test_cases.description: Inspect campaign statistics. Demo account has one campaign; the model may call list-campaigns-tool first to resolve it.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns campaign statistics such as character, session, and moment counts for the user's campaign.

test_cases.description: Ask a campaign knowledge question. Demo account is seeded with characters/factions; the model may resolve the campaign first.
test_cases.user_prompt: Using Archivist AI, who is Boromir in my campaign?
test_cases.expected_output: Returns a natural-language answer with citations pointing at campaign sources such as characters or factions.

test_cases.description: Find approved player characters. Demo account has one campaign; the model may call list-campaigns-tool first to resolve it.
test_cases.user_prompt: List approved player characters in my campaign.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns approved PC character records with names and character metadata. Empty list is acceptable only if the seeded campaign has no approved PCs.

test_cases.description: Create a new NPC character in the seeded demo campaign. The model should resolve the campaign ID first.
test_cases.user_prompt: In my Archivist AI campaign, create a new NPC named Mira Vale with a short description that she is a cautious town scribe.
test_cases.expected_output: Creates a character and returns the new character record (or success payload with id), including a name matching Mira Vale.

test_cases.description: Update an existing character description after reading it with wikilinks preserved. Prefer a character created in the prior write test or a seeded NPC.
test_cases.user_prompt: Find Mira Vale in my Archivist AI campaign, read her with links preserved, and update her description to say she keeps the town ledger.
test_cases.expected_output: Updates the character and returns the updated character record whose description reflects the ledger detail. The get/list call should request with_links true before writing.

test_cases.description: Create a quest in the seeded demo campaign.
test_cases.user_prompt: Create a new side quest called The Broken Crown in my Archivist AI campaign.
test_cases.expected_output: Creates a quest named The Broken Crown and returns the new quest record or success payload with id.

test_cases.description: Retrieve a session with related story context. Demo account is seeded with sessions; the model may list campaigns and sessions first.
test_cases.user_prompt: Open a game session from my campaign and include related beats and moments.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns session details (title, summary, session_date) and includes beats and/or moments when include_beats and include_moments are requested.

test_cases.description: Check image generation quota before generating. Demo account must have image access; model resolves campaign first.
test_cases.user_prompt: Check my Archivist AI image generation usage for my campaign.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns image quota fields such as used, limit, tier, and can_access for the campaign.

test_cases.description: Delete a disposable test record created earlier (quest The Broken Crown) to exercise a destructive write path safely.
test_cases.user_prompt: Delete the quest named The Broken Crown from my Archivist AI campaign.
test_cases.expected_output: Deletes the matching quest and returns a success payload. Reviewers should confirm a confirmation prompt appears because delete-quest-tool is destructive.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for unrelated calendar requests.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: What meetings do I have tomorrow?
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because calendar data is outside its supported workflows.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for general tabletop advice that does not require campaign records.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Give me five tips for running a better combat encounter.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because the request does not require reading or writing the user's campaign data.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for email/send workflows outside Archivist AI.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Email my players the session summary from last night.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because sending email is outside Archivist AI's supported tools.
